referents.why: Third feminine singular 'this' in 'this is the finger of God' points at the gnat-making, which no candidate carries. The finger (w6) is the predicate, not the referent.
referents.category: demonstrative pointing outside the candidate list

referents.why: 'them' is third masculine plural after 'he would not listen to them': the magicians (w3), the speakers in the preceding speech.
'he would not listen' is the act of a person; the heart (w11) hardened but does not listen. The sensible doer is Pharaoh (w5).
referents.category: subject of a refusal, not the heart

links.why: ka'asher, just as, before a saying clause: the refusal matches what the LORD had said.
Reversed: cl0 is the magicians' speech, which comes before the narrative of Pharaoh's heart.
cl1 is inside the magicians' speech; the wayyiqtol continues the narrative line from the saying clause cl0, not from a clause within the speech.
links.category: clause inside speech as narrative predecessor

links.why: wayyiqtol continues the narrative line from the nearest clause not inside a speech.
A will hardened, then the refusal that follows: the rule gives this as result, not a plain and.
Pharaoh's heart was hardened and so he would not listen.
cl0 is the magicians' saying; cl1 is what is said.

groups.why: The magicians speak to Pharaoh; the speech is the finger of God clause.

cant_tell.what: the referent of the demonstrative 'this' in cl1
cant_tell.why: It points at the act of producing gnats, which the candidate list does not carry. Only the feminine finger matches the morphology, and it is the predicate.
